Package common.hardware.motorcontroller

Class NAR_TalonFX

java.lang.Object
common.hardware.motorcontroller.NAR_Motor
common.hardware.motorcontroller.NAR_TalonFX
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class NAR_TalonFX extends NAR_Motor
A CTRE TalonFX motor controller, which drives Kraken X60, Kraken X44 and Falcon 500 motors, using Phoenix 6.

Every setting is kept in one TalonFXConfiguration. Changing a setting updates it and sends just that part to the Talon, retrying a few times if the Talon doesn't confirm.

The Talon's own control loops measure in rotations and rotations per second, output volts, and work in seconds. NAR_Motor converts gains and setpoints to and from your units.
